name: laughter
dialogue: Everything feels so heavy lately... I could use a reason to laugh again.

name: sleep
dialogue: I haven't slept well in days. My mind just won't quiet down.

name: detox
dialogue: I feel sluggish and foggy, like I'm carrying something I need to let go of.

name: stamina
dialogue: I have so much to do and no energy left to do it.

name: luck
dialogue: Nothing's been going my way lately... could a little luck really be bottled?

name: speed
dialogue: I'm always the last one to arrive. I wish my legs could keep up with my mind.

name: immunity
dialogue: Every cold in town seems to find me first. I need something to keep it away.

name: skin
dialogue: The wind up here is harsh. My skin's been dry and tired for weeks.

name: warmth
dialogue: The cold's been creeping into my bones. I just want to feel warm again.

name: anxiety
dialogue: My thoughts won't stop racing. I need something to help me feel steady.
